watchName: SFO/ORD to MNL enterprise airfare intelligence watch

trip.baggageAssumption: one carry-on plus one checked bag
trip.bookingRule: Book direct with the airline only. Discovery sites can surface opportunities, but BOOK states require airline-direct checkout proof for price, baggage, protected routing, and fare rules.

cadence.goal: Build route-specific historical ranges and catch early direct-airline sales.
Move from discovery tracking into real buy-window analysis.

cadence.frequency: three times weekly, then daily when historical-low pricing or high-volatility risk appears
cadence.goal: Lock a protected airline-direct fare before the strongest buy window closes.

book: Airline-direct checkout confirms final total, baggage, protected routing, and fare rules.
Verified fare is at or near the route-specific historical low band.
Route quality remains strong enough that modestly cheaper lower-quality connections do not outrank it.
watch: The fare is discovery-only or verification is incomplete.
Future drop probability still looks meaningful.
Historical-low proximity is good but not decisive enough for a buy call.
avoid: Basic Economy or similarly restrictive fare class for final booking.
Self-transfer, airport-change, or weak protected-routing structure.
Overnight layover unless the savings are exceptional.

verificationEvidence.routeValidationNotes: Aggregator signal only. Open united.com before treating this as actionable.

observations.expectedSaleWindowNote: United nonstop sales are usually brief; watch closely if direct checkout drops near the low-$500s.
observations.reboundPatternNote: Nonstop discounts tend to rebound quickly after a short sale window.
observations.qualityNotes: Best discovery signal because the nonstop structure removes connection stress, but it remains discovery-only until direct checkout confirms total price and fare rules.

observations.seatRestrictionNotes: Standard economy seat selection later in checkout; some extra-legroom seats cost more.
observations.changePenaltyNotes: $200 change fee plus any fare difference

verificationEvidence.pricingSnapshot: payment-page total 563 USD before optional extras
verificationEvidence.fareRulesSummary: Economy fare with 1 checked bag, seat fee only for premium locations, change fee applies.
verificationEvidence.routeValidationNotes: Single-airline protected nonstop routing. No airport transfer or transit visa issue.

observations.expectedSaleWindowNote: PAL nonstop pricing usually compresses fast once a real sale reaches the mid-$500s.
observations.reboundPatternNote: Fares often rebound sharply after a verified sale appears.

routeMetrics.aircraftType: Airbus A350 or Boeing 777 family, verify cabin map

observations.qualityNotes: Direct verified nonstop with a checked bag included and no connection stress. Slightly above the best discovery signal, but still near the route low with a cleaner buy profile.

observations.seatRestrictionNotes: Standard economy advance seat selection allowed with some seat fees.
observations.changePenaltyNotes: $180 change fee plus any fare difference

verificationEvidence.pricingSnapshot: payment-page total 547 USD before optional seat upsells
verificationEvidence.fareRulesSummary: Economy fare includes a checked bag and protected one-ticket routing via ICN.
verificationEvidence.routeValidationNotes: Protected one-stop routing with efficient ICN transfer and no airport change.

observations.expectedSaleWindowNote: One-stop premium Asian carrier fares can drift lower, but sub-$550 verified pricing is already competitive for ORD.
observations.reboundPatternNote: Post-sale rebounds are usually moderate rather than instant.

routeMetrics.aircraftType: Boeing 777/787 long-haul plus regional widebody or narrowbody, verify schedule

observations.qualityNotes: Strong premium-carrier backup with efficient ICN timing and protected baggage transfer, but still slightly less convenient than a true nonstop.

observations.seatRestrictionNotes: No free advance seat selection and stricter change limits than standard economy.

verificationEvidence.pricingSnapshot: payment-page total 519 USD before optional seat fees
verificationEvidence.fareRulesSummary: Basic Economy with checked bag included on this routing, but heavy seat and change restrictions remain.
verificationEvidence.routeValidationNotes: Protected same-airline itinerary, but fare class is too restrictive for a buy recommendation.

observations.expectedSaleWindowNote: Basic Economy often leads the price curve but should not drive the final booking call.
observations.reboundPatternNote: Low headline pricing can remain while standard economy moves higher.

routeMetrics.aircraftType: Mixed domestic + transpacific fleet, verify long-haul segment

observations.qualityNotes: Verified protected routing, but the fare family is too restrictive to qualify as a buy even though the headline price is attractive.

observations.seatRestrictionNotes: Standard economy seat rules with some paid seat zones.
observations.changePenaltyNotes: $220 change fee plus any fare difference

verificationEvidence.pricingSnapshot: payment-page total 506 USD before optional seat charges
verificationEvidence.fareRulesSummary: Economy fare with protected routing and included checked bag, but overnight layover increases fatigue cost.
verificationEvidence.routeValidationNotes: Protected routing, no airport change, but overnight airport wait materially hurts usability.

observations.expectedSaleWindowNote: Cathay can dip again, especially when overnight or less attractive bank timings are involved.
observations.reboundPatternNote: The ugliest schedules can stay discounted without immediate rebound pressure.

routeMetrics.aircraftType: Long-haul widebody plus regional connection, verify timing

observations.qualityNotes: Very good airline quality, but the overnight HKG wait is the kind of structure that should only win if the price becomes exceptionally aggressive.
